{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to prioritize latest test
data_sorted = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Deduplicate: keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
data_deduped = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data_deduped[(data_deduped['arm'] == 'control') & (data_deduped['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()

# Print the result
print(fraction_responded)"}
